items.claim: Chanel Dyer is a significantly better striker than Elise Reed.
items.quote: Chanel Dyer is 10 times the striker.

items.claim: Mason Jones has chaotic and relentless forward pressure with mixed striking and wrestling.
items.quote: He's just so chaotic and he's just such an absolute mess of a person when he moves forward. He's just throwing, he's swinging, he's wrestling.

items.claim: Ryan Kusay has been finished and lost in the past.
items.quote: a dude that's been finished before, a dude that's lost before

items.claim: Chris Padilla utilizes forward pressure and grimy fighting style to disrupt opponents who want to strike at distance.
items.quote: He moves forward. He gets in your face. He's grimy. He's gritty. He doesn't let you stay pretty and do pretty things.

items.claim: Nazarat Hack has very good defensive wrestling.
items.quote: Nazarat has very very good defensive wrestling

items.claim: Vitor Petino has shown a tendency to quit when fights get tough.
items.quote: We've seen him quit. Things get tough, he's out.

items.claim: Sergey Spivak has improved significantly since his fight against Alexey Oleinik years ago.
items.quote: Since then, he's really starting to put it together.

items.claim: Vitor Petino has struggled defensively in the grappling and lacks strong offensive wrestling.
items.quote: I have seen Vtor Patino struggle defensively in the grappling and I have seen him not get takedowns because his offensive grappling isn't that good.

items.claim: Gregory Rodrigues is a jiu-jitsu black belt with massive punching power.
items.quote: He's a jiu-jitsu black belt. He hits like an absolute freight train.
